title: Universal Life Insurance Claims Reference Table: Death Claim Interest and Beneficiary Limits
content:
For death claims and beneficiary designations on Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance, each tier carries the following figures.

## Reference table

| Item | Lifetime Guarantee UL | Protection UL | Accumulation UL | Indexed UL Protect | Indexed UL Growth | Indexed UL Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Death claim interest rate (annual, simple, from death to disbursement) | 3.5% | 3.5% | 3.5% | 3.5% | 3.5% | 3.5% |
| Smallest payee share that may be settled into an Ashgrove Beneficiary Access Account | $10000 | $10000 | $10000 | $10000 | $10000 | $25000 |
| Most primary beneficiaries | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Smallest beneficiary share (whole percent) | 1% | 1% | 1% | 1% | 1% | 1% |
| Age below which a share is paid only to a guardian or UTMA custodian | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 |

The death claim interest rate is 0.035 written as a decimal.

## Reading the table

- A payee share of exactly $10000 meets the Beneficiary Access Account threshold on the first five tiers; on the Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier the threshold is $25000, so a share of $10000 does not meet it there.
- A beneficiary aged 17 is below 18; a beneficiary aged 18 is not.
- A designation may name up to 10 primary beneficiaries, each with a share of at least 1%.

## Hypothetical figure

A payee share of $120000.00 earns 3.5% simple interest; over 73 days that is $120000.00 times 0.035 times 73 over 365, which is $840.00.
